objective: Find an eight-parameter four-qubit ring QNN with a defensible accuracy-runtime balance, without assuming it improves the existing model.

fixed.readout: Basis integer modulo 3, class order alfalfa/maize/wheat; groups 6/5/5
fixed.preprocessing: StandardScaler -> full-SVD PCA4 -> StandardScaler; fit inside each training fold
fixed.probabilities: Exact, no noise or finite-shot sampling
fixed.optimizer_implementation: Reuse verified NativeQiskitClassifier.fit/loss_gradient; no optimizer or gradient changes

training_CV.folds: Previous 3 stratified training folds (split seed 2026); not geographic
training_CV.reference: Fresh nine CV fits of verified two-block, twelve-angle ring, L-BFGS-B cap 100; require historical reproduction
training_CV.SVM: Original fixed 13-feature RBF-SVM; three folds, deterministic (no artificial seed replicates)

selection.metric: Mean of three seed-specific pooled OOF macro-F1 scores
selection.eligible: Eight-angle mean OOF F1 >= best mean among all tested quantum candidates minus .01; worst-seed OOF F1 >= twelve-angle ring worst-seed OOF F1 minus .01
selection.cost: Median of the three seed-specific sums of preprocess+fit+inference seconds over three folds
selection.choice: Lowest cost among eligible eight-angle candidates; exact cost ties favor higher mean F1 then lower call cap
selection.fallback: If none qualify, choose the highest-mean-F1 eight-angle candidate for honest evaluation, label quality criterion unmet; do not claim success
selection.pareto: Record nondominated mean-F1/cost candidates including the twelve-angle reference
selection.uncertainty: Three initialization seeds on reused training folds; no independent-sample confidence claim

models: Original eight-angle LINEAR QNN using same cached evaluator
post_selection_evaluation.policy: No validation-based candidate/seed reselection, budget extension, or architecture tuning; no test inference

runtime.main_training: Same local Qiskit Statevector.evolve(Operator(bound ansatz)) cached-input evaluator for every quantum candidate/reference; serial fits
runtime.inference: Same standard SamplerQNN + QMLSampler(shots=None) for all quantum candidates; no input-state cache in reported inference
runtime.reported: Preprocessing, fit (including input-state preparation), inference, total; objective calls, gradient calls, probability passes and logical field evaluations
runtime.engine_microbenchmark: Three fixed-weight 914-field forward passes per quantum architecture: cached Qiskit evaluator versus standard SamplerQNN, with equality checks; this is not measured standard optimizer training time
runtime.historical: 0.8557/0.8797/0.8943 and ~6.25s are labeled historical; current comparisons use fresh same-machine runs
